title: San Diego Mountain Hike and Meditation Tour
includes: Each participant will receive a thoughtfully equipped light backpack filled with all the essentials for a successful day in nature.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Participants must wear closed toe shoes, no sandals allowed.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
During this guided tour in San Diego, customers will receive a transformative experience immersed in nature. The tour includes a calming guided meditation led by an experienced teacher, and a mountain hike up a beautiful mountain surrounded by real sage plants to cleanse inner chaos. Lastly, participants will embark on a quiet nature walk to release inner pain to Mother Nature, leaving them feeling rejuvenated and refreshed.

Embark on this nature tour for a perfect blend of adventure, relaxation, and connection with your inner self! This is one of the most unique things to do in San Diego.
